description: NAS Parallel Benchmarks Integer Sort (faithful port): 10 rank() iterations over near-gaussian randlc keys; each iteration perturbs two keys, histograms the full [0,MAX_KEY) range, and computes ranks with an inclusive scan. Class sizes S/W/A/B/C use published MAX_KEY and verification tables; other sizes use MAX_KEY=size/16. Default size is Class A.

scaling_param.name: size
scaling_param.description: Number of integer keys to sort

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Cold-cache calibration: when true, a vector-add warmer boosts the GPU clock and evicts the last-level cache before each timed iteration, so the kernel is measured cold-cache at a boosted clock (matching a cold-cache simulator). Set false for legacy warm-cache measurement.
